sum: proposal store write batching: cold IndexAll must not pay one commit per file — R-01KY9CJV7GE76BN4XZ2356C3QC measured 21-24s cold for 5000 files - one synchronously committed Exec per Put. Add Flush() error to store.Store (mem no-op); sqlite store buffers Puts in a single transaction committed on Flush/Close; IndexAll calls Flush once after the parse loop. Target: cold 5000-file synth tree well under 3s for the store note: flush batching landed with T-01KY9M5PQ0F1GRYE9D5CBNTWYR: 11.3x faster cold IndexAll

txt: WHEN `Put` is called outside an open transaction, the parse-blob store SHALL open a lazy write transaction that `Flush` or `Close` commits, while `Get` reads through the open transaction uncommitted.
